name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
summary: Renferrel sends his research south to Tarren Mill, where the Forsaken press on with their plague studies. You carry his notes from Silverpine Forest to Apothecary Lydon in Hillsbrad Foothills.

sections.title: A Plague of Their Own
sections.body: Since escaping the Lich King's control, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has pursued a New Plague that could destroy both the living and the Scourge. The Royal Apothecary Society works under the Banshee Queen's relentless pressure to create it. Its researchers are scattered across Lordaeron, so they share chemical data and test findings to hasten their work.

sections.title: The Road South
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel works from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and sends you south with his recent findings for Apothecary Lydon. Your road leaves the pine woods and crosses the open pastures of Hillsbrad Foothills. Tarren Mill lies beneath the Alterac Mountains, serving the Forsaken as an outpost and a place to stage their research.

faq.answer: Renferrel's notes document his experiments with local plants, animals, and biological toxins. They contribute to the Royal Apothecary Society's work on the New Plague.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society in such a rush?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner demands quick results. The Forsaken face hostile human remnants, the Scarlet Crusade, and wandering Scourge. They believe a biological weapon can secure their survival and avenge Arthas.

Apothecary Lydon is a senior Royal Apothecary Society researcher stationed in Tarren Mill. Respected by Renferrel and his other peers, he oversees biological experiments in Hillsbrad Foothills, refining plague strains with local supplies and captives.

aliases: how to get to tarren mill
faq.answer: Tarren Mill lies in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, south of the Alterac Mountains and east of Silverpine Forest. Follow the main roads south from Silverpine, then turn east at the crossroads to reach it.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken have to share findings via foot couriers?
faq.answer: Renferrel asks you to carry his written findings from the Sepulcher to Lydon in Tarren Mill. He wants the Society's distant researchers to share discoveries quickly, but gives no reason for using foot couriers instead of magical means.

faq.q: What happens after Lydon gets the research?
faq.answer: After receiving Renferrel's notes, Apothecary Lydon begins studying them and working their findings into his own concoctions. He later asks adventurers to test improved strains on the local human population.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help advance your people's efforts to survive and avenge themselves against the living and the Scourge.
As Horde, you help secure the Forsaken's hold in Hillsbrad and strengthen the Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms, despite orc and tauren misgivings about underhanded poisons.
As a herbalist, you know that Renferrel and Lydon study and gather virulent, mutated plants from across Lordaeron.
